summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Senate control moved sharply toward the Democrats, who are the favoured party. In [[Mississippi]], the Democrat Scott Colom gained a lot of ground against the Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith, and the market treats the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts also strengthened considerably in a race that includes Dan Osborn, an independent, and a Democrat. The projected Senate count recently changed to 49-51, down from 50-50, and Republicans keep control.
summaries.governor: Four governor's races saw sharp moves in the Polymarket odds over the last day. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained a lot of ground, and the market treats the seat as a predicted flip. The Democrats Cindy Holscher in [[Kansas]] and Tina Kotek in Oregon also strengthened sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democrats to win control of the House rose by a sizable amount, with the party still the market's favourite. The projected seat count recently changed to 235-197-1, down from 240-193-1, and it still means Democrats gain control. In North Carolina, the Democrats Cyril Jefferson in [[NC-06 (High Point & Kannapolis)]] and Lakesha Womack in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]] each gained sharply, and the market lists both seats as predicted flips.
